defaultPrompt: Prefer Fusion for supported inspection. Give fusion_assist a short goal; batch known operations through fusion_inspect. Jev selects validated IDs only.

Host owns reasoning, edits, permissions and correctness. Run chosen commands through fusion-jev run -- program argv...; use RTK/native tools when unavailable or unsupported. Continue in the current host on escalation.
